notes: Every primary added failure is retained. Only names failing on the candidate but passing on main in the first paired control receive one further sequential paired diagnostic, with default-reporter logs. The paired summary uses the latest diagnostic per name; the original runs remain linked. Passing an isolated retry is not a passing broad/full suite.

The broad run overlapped the final fixes: its three added boundary failures are red evidence, resolved in final web 517/517. Its one suite-load failure is the JS classifier test selected before that deliberately deferred module/test was removed. The final entire web selection and explicit renderer/module absence checks pass. No broad all-green result is claimed.
